value.value: The obligations of the Borrower under this Agreement constitute unsecured, general obligations of the Borrower. In order to secure, on behalf of the Authority, the obligation of the Borrower to make Payments, concurrently with the reoffering of the Bonds, the Borrower shall issue and deliver to the Trustee a series of its notes (the “Notes”) under the Senior Notes Indenture
value.note: verbatim: “The obligations of the Borrower under this Agreement constitute unsecured, general obligations of the Borrower.”

value.value: Events of Default (Section 10.1): (a) Event of Default under the Indenture, the Notes or the Senior Notes Indenture; (b) default in timely payment of any Payment (30-day grace for Term Rate interest); (c) failure to perform any other covenant for 30 days after notice; (d) bankruptcy decree/order unstayed 90 consecutive days; (e) voluntary bankruptcy/insolvency. Mandatory prepayment (Section 7.1): Borrower shall prepay if (a) Agreement becomes void/unenforceable; (b) a Determination of Taxability occurs; (c) Bond proceeds remain after completion of the Projects.
value.note: verbatim: “The terms “Event of Default” and “Default” shall mean any one or more of the following events: (a) An Event of Default shall exist under the Indenture, the Notes or the Senior Notes Indenture; (b) The Borrower shall default in the timely payment of any Payment pursuant to Article IV of this Agreement; provided that such default with respect to an interest payment in the case of a Bond bearing interest at a Term Rate shall be deemed to occur upon the continuance of any such failure of payment for a period of 30 days after the applicable Interest Payment Date”

value.value: The Borrower agrees to pay to the Trustee amounts sufficient for the payment in full in satisfaction of a Change of Control Offer
value.note: verbatim: “The Borrower agrees to pay to the Trustee amounts sufficient for the payment in full in satisfaction of a Change of Control Offer (“Change of Control Payment”). The Change of Control Payment with respect to the Bonds shall be payable directly to the Trustee for the account of the Borrower Designee on the Change of Control Payment Date.”

value.value: payment in full in satisfaction of an Asset Sale Offer (as defined in the Senior Notes Indenture)
value.note: verbatim: “The Borrower agrees to pay to the Trustee amounts sufficient for the payment in full in satisfaction of an Asset Sale Offer (as defined in the Senior Notes Indenture) (“Asset Sale Payment”). The Asset Sale Payment with respect to the Bonds shall be payable directly to the Trustee for the account of the Borrower on the completion of the Asset Sale Offer.”

value.value: each February 1 and August 1, commencing August 1, 2010
value.note: verbatim: ““Interest Payment Date” or “interest payment date”, when used with respect to the Bonds, means each February 1 and August 1, commencing August 1, 2010; provided however, with respect to the Company Bonds (Series 2009A-1) held on the Final Drawing Date only, Interest Payment Date shall mean July 2, 2010.”

verbatim: “The initial aggregate amount of the Lenders' Commitments is $1,000,000,000.”

value.value: Eurodollar Borrowings: Adjusted LIBO Rate plus the Applicable Rate; ABR Borrowings: Alternate Base Rate plus the Applicable Rate

(b) The Loans comprising each Eurodollar Borrowing (including all Alternate Currency Loans) shall bear interest at the Adjusted LIBO Rate for the Interest Period in effect for such Borrowing plus the Applicable Rate.”

value.value: Total Leverage Ratio not to exceed: (a) 3.00 to 1.00 to Changeover Date; (b) 3.50 to 1.00 from Changeover Date to December 31, 2017; (c) 3.00 to 1.00 thereafter
value.note: verbatim: “SECTION 6.09. Financial Covenant . The Company will not permit the Total Leverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter of the Company to exceed: (a) from the Effective Date to the date the Company delivers a certificate to the Administrative Agent certifying that the commitments under the Bridge Facility have been terminated in full (the “ Changeover Date ”), 3.00 to 1.00 ... (b) from the Changeover Date to December 31, 2017, 3.50 to 1.00; and (c) thereafter, 3.00 to 1.00.”

value.value: Guaranteed by the Company and each Subsidiary Guarantor (each Subsidiary that is not an Excluded Subsidiary); unsecured (opinions cover 'an unsecured bank loan financing')
value.note: verbatim: ““ Guarantors ” means the Company and each Subsidiary Guarantor. ... SECTION 11.01. The Guaranty . (a) The Company hereby unconditionally guarantees ... (b) Each Subsidiary Guarantor hereby unconditionally guarantees to the Administrative Agent, for the benefit of the Lenders, the full and punctual payment ... of the principal of, and interest and fees on, each Loan made to and each LC Disbursement incurred by any Borrower”

value.value: Events of Default per Section 7.01 (clauses (a)-(n)) including payment defaults, covenant breaches, cross-default on Material Indebtedness, bankruptcy, judgments above Threshold Amount, ERISA Event, Change in Control, guarantee termination. Mandatory repayments per Section 2.09(d): if Total Revolving Credit Exposure exceeds Commitments or Total Alternate Currency Revolving Credit Exposure exceeds Alternate Currency Sublimit, Borrowers shall within five Business Days prepay outstanding Loans
value.note: verbatim: “SECTION 7.01. Events of Default . If any of the following events (“ Events of Default ”) shall occur and be continuing: (a) any Borrower shall fail to pay any principal of any Loan ... (m) a Change in Control shall occur; or (n) ... the guarantee of any Guarantor under Article XI shall ... be terminated”
verbatim: ““ Threshold Amount ” means $75,000,000.”
verbatim: ““ Alternate Currency Sublimit ” means $250,000,000.”

value.value: The Loan Agreement does not state a numeric interest rate; the Notes bear "interest at an interest rate at all times equal to the interest rate borne by the Bonds, payable on the dates on which interest is payable on the Bonds" (Section 4.6(a)(ii)), and Interest Payments are "an amount sufficient for the payment in full of the total interest due and payable ... on the Bonds" (Section 4.2(a)(i)); the rate itself is set in the Indenture/Bonds, not stated in this exhibit.
value.note: verbatim: “"Interest Payments" being an amount sufficient for the payment in full of the total interest due and payable to the date of payment thereof on the Bonds from time to time issued under the Indenture and then outstanding.”

value.value: Section 4.5: Borrower shall prepay as necessary to accomplish the extraordinary mandatory redemption of the Bonds; Special Payments include Change of Control Payment and Asset Sale Payment (Section 4.2(b)).
